text: {"overall_winner":"B","qualities":[{"evidence":"Dear principal i am writhing this letter","quality":"task-appropriate opening","description":"It uses a more fitting introductory frame for a persuasive letter and addresses the audience directly."},{"evidence":"because is something good for the school and for the student","quality":"cohesive argumentation","description":"It connects reasons more explicitly to the central claim and maintains a more organized persuasive line."},{"evidence":"some student would like the idea... and other would not like the idea","quality":"counterargument handling","description":"It acknowledges the opposing view more clearly and then brings the response back to the writer's position."},{"evidence":"something healthier... to see what it would happend in the futere","quality":"idea development","description":"It develops the point with more specific explanation rather than repeating the same claim in different words."},{"evidence":"aprove your oppinion","quality":"word choice precision","description":"It generally uses more context-appropriate vocabulary for an opinion letter, even though it still has errors."},{"evidence":"the school menu ... the school lunch","quality":"topic control","description":"It stays more consistently focused on one prompt-related issue without drifting as much into unrelated general warnings."}]}
